names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 ianuarie, «Sfântul Mucenic Ermil».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιοι Έρμυλος και Στρατόνικος», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life sets the passion in the reign it dates «Împărățind Liciniu păgânul (307-324)»; it gives no year of its own.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Ιανουαρίου — «Άγιοι Έρμυλος και Στρατόνικος»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nestricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Mucenici Ermil şi Stratonic

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received the crowns of incorruption from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength they cast down the tyrants and broke also the feeble boldness of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: De zbuciumul cel lumesc aţi fugit şi la limanul cel lin v-aţi mutat, prin sângiurile muceniciei; şi cu ostenelile pustniciei v-aţi încununat. Pentru aceasta v-aţi şi arătat cu mucenicii şi cuvioşii împreună locuitori.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfinţilor Mucenici Ermil şi Stratonic; printed to the melody «Căutând cele de sus...»

english.text: You fled the tumult of the world and passed over to the quiet haven through the blood of martyrdom; and you were crowned with the labours of the hermit's life. Therefore you were shown to be fellow dwellers with the martyrs and with the venerable ones.

hymns.text: Οἱ Μάρτυρες σου Κύριε, ἐν τῇ ἀθλήσει αὐτῶν, τὸ στέφος ἐκομίσαντο τῆς ἀφθαρσίας, ἐκ σοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν· σχόντες γὰρ τὴν ἰσχύν σου, τοὺς τυράννους καθεῖλον· ἔθραυσαν καὶ δαιμόνων τὰ ἀνίσχυρα θράση. Αὐτῶν ταῖς ἱκεσίαις Χριστέ ὁ Θεός, σῶσον τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιοι Έρμυλος και Στρατόνικος, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον (the common of martyrs, printed under their names)

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contending received the crown of incorruption from thee our God; for having thy strength they cast down the tyrants, and broke also the powerless insolence of the demons. By their entreaties, O Christ God, save our souls.

locations.note: doxologia.ro's life: he was drowned in the Danube, and the bodies were buried «ca la 18 stadii departe de cetatea Singhidon (Belgrad)».
